summary.text: Madeleine Dean is the Democratic incumbent, in the U.S. House since 2019. A former lawyer, college writing and ethics instructor and columnist, she served as an Abington Township commissioner and in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from 2012 to 2018 before winning the 4th District seat in 2018. In the 119th Congress (2025-2026) she serves on the House Appropriations and House Foreign Affairs committees.

paragraphs.text: Born in 1959 and raised in Glenside, Pennsylvania, with five older brothers and one older sister; graduated from Abington High School and, at age 18, won election as a local committeeperson.
Earned a B.A. in English language and literature from La Salle University (1981) and a J.D. from Widener University School of Law (1984).
Practiced law in a small Philadelphia firm and with the Philadelphia Trial Lawyers Association, where she became executive director, then opened a small law practice in Glenside.

From 2001 to 2011 was a member of La Salle University's English Department, teaching writing and ethics, and contributed columns to The Philadelphia Inquirer, the Daily News, The Patriot-News and other publications.

After studying politics and public service at the University of Pennsylvania's Fels School of Government, was elected an Abington Township commissioner in 2011 and won a special election to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives (District 153) in 2012, serving until 2018.

In the Pennsylvania House, founded and co-chaired the PA-SAFE Caucus, a coalition of legislators and advocates focused on gun violence; in 2015 Gov. Tom Wolf appointed her to the Pennsylvania Commission for Women.

Won election to the U.S. House in 2018 for the 4th District, at a time when, her official biography notes, Pennsylvania's 18-member House delegation included no women; in the 118th Congress served on the Judiciary Committee (vice chair in 2021-2022) and the Foreign Affairs Committee.
Serves in her fourth term on the House Appropriations and House Foreign Affairs committees. Her official biography says she is married to PJ Cunnane and they have three sons and seven grandchildren.
